name: context-menu-animated

frames.best_why: The full menu is open with shortcut hints, checkmarks and the selected person all visible.

tagline: Right-click menu that unfolds in a soft stagger with gliding highlights.
summary: A browser-style right-click menu with shortcut hints, a More Tools submenu, bookmark checkboxes and a people radio group; rows animate in sequence and the highlight glides between them.
appearance: A small dark rounded menu with a translucent frosted panel. One column lists Back, Forward and Reload with shortcut glyphs, More Tools with a chevron, two bookmark toggles with ticks, then a People label and two people rows with a tick. A faint Right click here hint sits behind.
behaviour: Right-clicking opens the menu near the pointer with a staggered blur-and-scale reveal, and the row highlight glides as the pointer moves. More Tools hands off to a second menu that morphs in beside it, and checks draw themselves in.
demo_content: Right click here; menu offers Back, Forward, Reload, More Tools, bookmark toggles and a People list.
use_when: A web app needs a desktop-style right-click menu with nested tools, toggles and a selection.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces: there is no long-press fallback, so the menu is hard to reach on phones.
customise: Menu structure, labels, shortcuts and icons are composed from exported parts; open state, animation transitions and reduced-motion behaviour come through props on the root and content.
weight_why: A large set of motion wrappers, but only a few nodes animate and only while opening.

a11y.note: Menu roles, keyboard control and focus return come from the underlying primitive, and reduced motion is explicitly handled.

polish_why: Fluid, well-tuned menu motion and a believable browser menu; the trigger hint is faint.
title: Context Menu (animated)
